means: Constructed replays, one per drawn node of shiwehi.com's はちみつ砲 route page: our own piece queue and key inputs, run from an empty board through the vendored Triangle engine, ending on the page's drawn board. Not a game anyone played and not corpus data.
not_eligible_because: not a game anyone played; not corpus data
one engine, no second implementation of the boards

caveat.order: Where the page does not fix the piece order, the order here is ours: the early piece first, the first piece of each of the page's before-pairs next, then IOTSZJL, the T into the TST slot last. order_reading records it per bag.
caveat.hold: bag1.j_hold holds its J when it arrives, just after L (the page: the later of J and L is held). The hold box is then never empty again: in bag 2 the held J comes out when the T arrives, and the T comes out for the TST when the next bag's first piece arrives; in a Perfect Clear bag that piece is the one the pattern does not use, and it stays held.
caveat.early: The page gives no threshold for "early"; the demo puts the early piece first in its bag.
caveat.spin_board: The page draws each bag-2 form with the TST slot empty and the T on a separate board (spin_board); the demo fires the T into that board's U cells.
caveat.ideal_chain: The fifteen Perfect Clear patterns hang under the five 2.ideal forms, which all leave the same board after the TST (2.ideal.after_tst); their demos run through 2.ideal#1.
caveat.spin: Every T-spin kind and line count is the engine's verdict on the replayed inputs.

board.coords: y-UP: row 0 is the bottom row

unbuilt.reason: 係「第一巡 六粒形」左右反轉（J↔L、S↔Z），逐格對過；用頁面嘅反轉掣睇
示意圖：五個理想形共用嘅 TST，每個 2.ideal#k 示範嘅最後一粒就係呢下 TST
示意圖：TST 之後嘅盤面，即係每個 2.ideal#k 示範打完之後嘅盤面
示意圖：2.compromise 示範嘅最後一粒就係呢下 TST
「p」格冇指定填法；佢嘅例就係 stmb_example 嘅示範
「B」格係我哋嘅讀法（REN 區，13 格，唔係一粒粒方塊），冇得逐粒砌
畫咗嘅舊格唔係上一層示範留低嘅盤面（第 1 欄，由底數第 0 行）
